We are seeking a dedicated IT Support Technician with expertise in Networking and Security to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in ensuring our IT infrastructure's reliability, security, and efficiency, supporting our operations across multiple locations.
- Monitor and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs.
- Perform regular audits of network security, including intrusion detection systems (IDS), to ensure compliance and identify potential vulnerabilities.
- Troubleshoot network issues and implement solutions to optimize performance and minimize downtime.
- Implement and manage security measures, such as firewalls, antivirus software, and encryption protocols, to protect against cyber threats.
- Provide technical support and training to end-users on networking and security-related issues.
- Collaborate with internal teams to implement and support business-critical applications and systems.
- Document network configurations, procedures, and security incidents for future reference and analysis.
- Stay informed about industry trends and best practices in networking and cybersecurity to continuously improve our IT environment.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently.
- Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, LAN/WAN technologies, and network protocols (e.g., DNS, DHCP, SNMP).
- Experience with network infrastructure devices (routers, switches, firewalls) and security tools (firewalls, IDS/IPS).
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V) is a plus.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders effectively.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced industry.
- Comprehensive health benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
- Retirement savings plan with company match.
- Paid time off and company holidays.
